comparison: All old readings versus all refreshed readings at the same sampling depth
note: Repeated readings reuse layouts and are not independent attacks. The refresh changes instruction framing and evidence wording together; differences do not identify a causal wording effect.

aggregation.baseline: Median of five readings per agent view; team score is maximum of member medians. Joint score is median of five group readings.
aggregation.A_B_C: Each exploration or fleet judgment is a decision; flag counts pool all passes at the fixed threshold.
